title: Apple design system cracked and integrated into Claude AI #shorts #apple #claude
description: This video introduces a newly created skill that replicates Apple's comprehensive design system within Claude, an AI coding assistant. The skill distills years of Apple's design standards—covering exact colors, fonts, motion rules, and other UI elements—into a single, easy-to-use tool. By integrating this into your projects, you can create premium animated websites that reflect Apple's polished aesthetic or enhance existing sites with precise design corrections. The tool works by analyzing your site according to Apple's authentic guidelines and returns detailed feedback highlighting discrepancies along with specific fixes. Installation involves a simple command-line setup within Claude, enabling rapid design reviews and improvements. This innovation streamlines the application of Apple's design principles, offering value to developers and designers aiming for high-quality, Apple-level interfaces. #AppleDesignSystem #ClaudeAI #UIDesign #AppleUIDesign #WebAnimation #DesignAutomation #AppleGuidelines #DesignTool #WebDevelopment #CodingTool #UXDesign #TechInnovation #DesignReview #WebDesign #AppleStyle
